items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: My name, Johnson was a banjo player. I was on the bass.

ctx.x: Wallace, uh... Geek was a planet man. And we had oil, violin player. My name, Johnson was a banjo player. I was on the bass. Florence Mills, she was singing. You knew Florence Mills, don't you?
I heard of her. All right. I remember.
